title: Service status
description: The status of one service: its name, its state, when the state was last updated, and optionally a message and the state of each component.

service.title: Service
service.description: The service's name, as the widget's heading prints it.

state.title: State
state.description: The service's state as a whole.

updated.title: Updated
updated.description: When the status was last updated, as an RFC 3339 date-time. The widget writes it for a reader in the offset it carries, as 20 October 2026, 08:15 UTC, and keeps it as given in the time element's datetime attribute.

message.title: Message
message.description: One or two sentences on what readers should know: what is affected, or when work ends. Left out, the widget shows the state alone.

components.title: Components
components.description: The parts of the service whose state readers follow separately, in the order the widget lists them.

name.title: Component name
name.description: The component's name, as the list prints it.

state.title: State
state.description: operational: working normally. degraded: working, slower or with some failures. outage: not working. maintenance: down or limited for planned work.
